children: Lexaria Bioscience received an AUD 3,666,611.98 (USD 2.6M) Australian R&D tax credit tied to its GLP-1 clinical study.
Received AUD 3,666,611.98 (USD 2.6M) tax credit from the Australian Tax Office for R&D costs on study GLP-1-H24-4.
Credit was deposited into the Australian bank account of Lexaria (AU) Pty Ltd, the company’s wholly owned Australian subsidiary.
Funds are intended to pursue additional research and development opportunities in Australia.
